summary: I read the hub whole and all 24 source pages, plus the Inharmonic Wavetable and Hero and Avatar Maker bundles where a reason might hide. The pattern: where a source names the hub in a sentence about its idea (Progressive Staging, Dissolutions, Differential Equations, Latent Error, Striatum, Palace Philosophies, FOUR PILLARS, Simondon) a one-to-two word label carries it; Endosymbiosis is a true mirror; Inharmonic Wavetable's enables was backwards and is really a deepening of the hub's open frustrated-coupling question; Fuller already holds a reason on the page and stays. Ten bare or unsaid links to a floor hub (Closing Well, Multilinear Self, Shepard, Bessel, Wallpaper, Symbiotic Skills, Frequency-Time Duality, Retrospective Delay, Walk That Weaves, Pages as Agents) plus Hero and Avatar Maker are cuts, none a loss. What I could not settle: Slime Mold Delay (my adaptive-coupling retype leans on the hub's Hebbian open question, not on the slime-mold page naming coupling; low-medium) and whether Synthesis-Emergence should keep a mirror at all. I found no genuine inbound link to propose from a newcomer in this room, so typed_relations is empty.
